There is a surge in the demand for rental accommodation, as the IT ecosystem in Hyderabad continues to grow. Most new arrivals have opted for PG accommodation over apartments for the flexibility and convenience.

Some of the biggest reasons behind the increasing demand of PG in Hyderabad are:

  • Growing number of IT professionals moving into the city

  • Booming startup scene in technology companies!

  • Huge student population flocking for higher studies

  • Popularity of flexible short-term letting options


Commercial apartment leases can be rigid, with:

  • Security deposits ranging from 5 to 10 months
  • Brokerage fees

  • Long lock-ins are not uncommon

PG living can address many of these problems, since they provide immediate accommodation and basic amenities.Many professionals also compare similar IT hubs like PG in Whitefield before finalizing where to stay.
